title: Roast pumpkin and smoked haddock salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple, such as pumpkin, potatoes, smoked haddock, eggs, milk, mustard and cider vinegar.

supermarket.reason: Pumpkin, smoked haddock and watercress are all everyday Tesco items in October at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a saucepan and a frying pan, and boiling eggs and poaching fish are beginner techniques.

works.reason: 1kg pumpkin, 500g potatoes, 500g haddock and four eggs suit four people, halved small potatoes and pumpkin cubes roast through in 35 minutes at 200°C, and the dressing ratio is sound.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and cubing the pumpkin and halving the potatoes fit in 25 minutes, the eggs, fish and dressing can be done while the veg roasts, and the 35-minute roast matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including thyme and chives, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm roast pumpkin salad with smoked haddock suits late October, and the pumpkin is the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Roast veg, potatoes, fish and eggs make a filling, balanced family dinner.
